incoming_learnings: Mandatory pool retrieval needs an executable preparation route. Check hunger admission, safe unknown-drink geometry, inventory protection, entrance readiness and the protected return budget together. A floor-supply expectation does not identify any potion. Preserve the chest obligation and terminal planner-failure label. Other backlog cases were not re-investigated here.

review.review: The hero stopped alive at full health because the planner exhausted recovery, not because the game clock froze. A completed pool-approach scout repeatedly preempted key collection: decision 470 reached cell 637, decision 471 resumed key work, and decision 472 restarted the same scout. Subsequent route-stall and loop exclusions accumulated before planner failure at decision 610. Offline source-pinned reconstruction matched original actions and reasons through decision 476. The proposed arrival-receipt correction matches through 471, then selects the existing key-progress step at 472; reconstruction stops there. The new regression fails by the expected assertion on original policy and passes on the candidate. The full suite passes. This establishes removal of a stale scouting detour, not successful key collection, pool preparation or survival. Potion identities, hazard admission, mandatory pickups and the terminal failure label remain unchanged.
review.learnings: Remember an actually observed scouting arrival separately from protection or collection. Returning to other floor work must not restart that completed detour. Pool supply feasibility remains a separate problem: validate an admitted entrance scout, return and inventory protection before any unknown drink. Other backlog cases were not re-investigated.
